# Turn one interview into a month of content for every platform

> Answer one guided interview about your brand or topic and get a 4-week content calendar with drafts for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, newsletters, blogs and more. Free, runs in your browser, optional AI on your own key.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/interview-content-studio/)
- [How often to post on each platform, and how to fill the calendar from one interview](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/interview-content-studio/how-often-to-post-on-each-platform.html)
